description: List the public (and optionally bank/observance) holidays for one country (and region) in one year, 2020-2035, with local names, types and official source links. Read-only. Same data, cache and limits as GET /v1/holidays.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. US, DE, GB. See list_countries.

region.description: Optional region/state code for countries with regional holidays, e.g. DE-BY, US-CA (or just BY).

types.description: Optional comma list of public, bank, observance, or "all" (default: all).

name: get_holidays
title: List public holidays for a country and year
